lang.label: Language
nav.label: Main
guard.title: This page is not for your role
guard.body: The temple office can change what you are allowed to see. You can go back to your own page.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page may have moved, or the link is not complete.
pager.label: Pages
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Initiation office, ISKCON Newtown. We send a one-time code to your email or phone.
login.identifierHint: Use the one the temple has for you.
login.identifierInvalid: Enter your email address or phone number.
login.codeSent: If this matches a person known to the temple, a 6-digit code has been sent. It works for 10 minutes.
login.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
login.changeIdentifier: Use a different email or phone
mfa.title: Second step
mfa.lead: The temple president and administrators confirm sign-in with an authenticator app.
mfa.enrolIntro: You have not set up your authenticator app yet. It takes a minute.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (any app that supports time-based codes).
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Type this key into the app instead:
mfa.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits shown in the app.
mfa.lostDevice: Lost access to your authenticator app? Ask the temple administrator to help you set it up again.
stage.label: Stages of the path
stage.caption: Stage {n} of {total}: {stage}
rule.R-1.label.first: Following the practice standard for at least {months} months
rule.R-1.label.second: Following the practice standard for at least {months} months (second initiation)
rule.R-1.detail.unknown: The mentor has not yet confirmed when the practice standard began.
rule.R-1.detail.met: Following the practice standard since {since}. {months} months were complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-1.detail.notMet: Following the practice standard since {since}. {months} months will be complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-2.label: Accepted in shelter for at least {months} months
rule.R-2.detail.unknown: The date of acceptance in shelter has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-2.detail.met: In shelter since {since}. {months} months were complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-2.detail.notMet: In shelter since {since}. {months} months will be complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-3.label: Examination passed
rule.R-3.detail.notTaken: The examination has not been taken yet.
rule.R-3.detail.failed: The examination was not passed. It can be taken again.
rule.R-3.detail.unknown: The examination result has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-4.label: Disciples Course complete, with the certificate on file
rule.R-4.detail.met: The course is complete and the certificate is on file.
rule.R-4.detail.noCertificate: The course is recorded as complete, but the certificate has not been uploaded yet.
rule.R-4.detail.notComplete: The course is not complete yet.
rule.R-4.detail.unknown: Whether the course is complete has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-5.label: The temple president's written recommendation
rule.R-5.detail.later: This comes after the president reviews the file.
rule.R-5.detail.met: The temple president has recommended this candidate.
rule.R-6.label: At least {months} months since the first initiation
rule.R-6.detail.unknown: The date of the first initiation has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-6.detail.met: First initiation on {since}. {months} months were complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-6.detail.notMet: First initiation on {since}. {months} months will be complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-7.label: At least {months} months since changing guru
rule.R-7.detail.unknown: The date the guru was changed has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-7.detail.met: Guru changed on {since}. {months} months were complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-7.detail.notMet: Guru changed on {since}. {months} months will be complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-8.label: At least {months} months since returning to ISKCON
rule.R-8.detail.unknown: The date of return has not been recorded yet.
rule.R-8.detail.met: Returned on {since}. {months} months were complete on {dueOn}.
rule.R-8.detail.notMet: Returned on {since}. {months} months will be complete on {dueOn}.
nextStep.heading: Your next step
nextStep.PASS_EXAM: Prepare for the examination and pass it.
nextStep.MENTOR_CONFIRM_PRACTICE: Your mentor confirms the date you began following the practice standard.
nextStep.RECORD_SHELTER_DATE: The temple office records the date you were accepted in shelter.
nextStep.RECORD_FIRST_INITIATION: The temple office records the date of the first initiation.
nextStep.WAIT_UNTIL: Nothing to do right now. The waiting period ends on {dueOn}.
nextStep.RECORD_FACT: The temple office needs to record one more detail.
nextStep.READY_FOR_REVIEW: Everything is in place. The file is ready for the temple president to review.
checklist.unknownNote: Needs confirming means nobody has checked it yet. It is not a fail.
error.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
error.MFA_REQUIRED: Please complete the second step of sign-in first.
error.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
error.NOT_FOUND: That could not be found. It may have been removed.
error.CONFLICT: This was changed by someone else, or already exists. Refresh the page and try again.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.OTP_INVALID: That code is not correct or is no longer valid. Check it, or ask for a new one.
error.OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.APPROVAL_BLOCKED: A recommendation cannot be given while items are unmet or need confirming and have no recorded exception.
error.INVALID_STAGE_TRANSITION: The file cannot move to that stage from where it is now.
error.RULE_BELOW_FLOOR: Some values are below the minimum that is allowed.
error.RULESET_NO_DRAFT: There is no draft to publish or discard.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large. Choose a smaller file, or a photo with a lower resolution.
error.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: That kind of file is not allowed. Use a PDF or a photo (JPG or PNG).
error.CEREMONY_NOT_PLANNED: This ceremony is no longer open for changes.
error.CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED: The guru's office has not accepted this candidate yet.
error.CONSENT_REQUIRED: The candidate's consent has to be recorded first.
error.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.RESPONSE_INVALID: The server sent something unexpected. Please try again, or tell the office.
error.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.field.NOT_WHOLE_MONTHS: Enter a whole number of months.
error.field.CANNOT_DISABLE: This rule is required and cannot be switched off.
error.field.EMAIL_OR_PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter an email address or a phone number.
error.field.LOGIN_NEEDS_CONTACT: A login needs a phone number or an email address.
path.stageCard: Where you are on the path
path.noGuru: You have not chosen a guru yet. The temple office will help.
path.sentBack: Sent back by the temple president
path.checklistTitle: What is done and what is missing
documents.privacy: A PDF or a photo from your phone camera. Only the candidate, the mentor and the temple office can open these files.
documents.removeBody: {name} (uploaded {date}) will be removed from the file. The removal is recorded.
notes.monthlyHint: Only the mentor, the committee and the president can read monthly notes. The candidate cannot.
candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.lead: Everyone in the process, from first contact to initiation.
candidates.leadMine: The people you mentor. You confirm what you have seen; the president recommends and the guru decides.
candidates.caption: Candidates
candidates.col.name: Candidate
candidates.emptyHint: Clear a filter, or add a candidate.
addCandidate.title: Add a candidate
addCandidate.name: Full name
addCandidate.guru: Guru the candidate intends to approach
addCandidate.guruHint: Can be chosen later. The checklist follows this guru's rule set.
addCandidate.createLogin: Create a login so the candidate can see their own path
addCandidate.createLoginHint: Needs a phone number or an email address.
addCandidate.loginNeedsContact: Enter a phone number or an email address, or turn off the login.
addCandidate.consentText: The candidate has been told what the temple stores about them (name, contact details, progress on the path, the documents they upload and notes about their path), who can see it (their mentor, the temple committee, the temple president, and the guru's office when they are recommended) and why (to prepare and record their initiation). They agree.
addCandidate.consentCheck: The candidate has been told this and agrees
addCandidate.consentRequired: Consent must be given before the candidate can be added.
facts.notRecorded: Not recorded yet. This is not a fail.
facts.unknownHint: Leave blank if not known yet. That is not a fail.
facts.optionalHint: Only if it applies to this person.
facts.readOnly: You can see these details but not change them.
submit.title: Submit to the temple president
submit.intro: Write a short note on why this person is ready. The president will see it with the checklist.
submit.unmetWarning: Some items are not met or need confirming. You can still submit; the president will see the checklist.
submit.confirmBody: {name}'s file moves to Applied and appears in the president's review queue.
advance.title: Move to the next stage
advance.shelterDate: Date the guru accepted them in shelter
advance.preparingIntro: Start preparation: the mentor can then submit a readiness note.
guru.label: Guru
guru.hint: The checklist then follows that guru's rule set.
exceptions.title: Written exceptions
exceptions.intro: An exception is a written reason that lets the president recommend even though an item is unmet or unconfirmed. It is recorded with your name.
exceptions.removeBody: {rule} will go back to its real status and may block the recommendation again.
exceptions.noneNeeded: Every item is met or has an exception.
recommendation.title: Your recommendation
recommendation.okNote: Every item the recommendation depends on is met or has a recorded exception. The guru's office, not this system, decides.
recommendation.blockedTitle: You cannot recommend yet. These are not met or need confirming, and no exception is recorded:
recommendation.blockedHelp: A committee member can record an exception. You can still send the file back or decline.
recommendation.reasonHint: The candidate and the mentor will read this.
recommendation.reasonRequired: A reason is required to send back or decline.
recommendation.confirmBody.APPROVE: You are recommending {name} to the guru's office. The recommendation letter is generated. The guru's office makes the decision.
recommendation.confirmBody.SEND_BACK: {name}'s file goes back to Preparing with your reason.
recommendation.confirmBody.DECLINE: The application of {name} will be closed with your reason.
recommendation.logged: Every decision is logged with your name, the time and the rule set version used.
guruResponse.title: The guru's office answer
guruResponse.intro: Record what the guru's office replied.
guruResponse.label: Answer
guruResponse.reasonRequired: A reason is needed when the answer is wait or declined.
handoff.title: Letter and package
handoff.package: Export package for the guru's office
handoff.packageHint: You see what is missing first, then download.
handoff.nothingUnmet: Every checklist item is met or has an exception.
handoff.logged: Exporting is logged, including anything missing. Checked {when}.
status.title: Status
timeline.caption: Timeline of this file
timeline.note: Every change is recorded with who made it and when. Recommendations also record the rule set version used.
queue.title: Review queue
queue.lead: Files whose mentors have submitted a readiness note, oldest first. You recommend or send back; the guru's office decides.
queue.caption: Files waiting for review
queue.legend: Each status is a word as well as a shape: a filled circle is met, a hollow circle needs confirming, a square is not met.
rules.title: Rule sets
rules.lead: The baseline rules for the temple and each guru's own rules. A guru's office can raise the GBC minimums and never lower them. Changes create a new version; recommendations already given keep the version they used.
rules.readOnly: You can read the rules but not change them.
rules.readOnlyHint: Only an administrator can change rule sets.
rules.newHint: Starts as a draft copied from the baseline.
rules.noFreeGurus: Every active guru already has a rule set.
rules.created: Rule set created as a draft.
rules.baselineIntro: The baseline applies when no guru is chosen. Values cannot go below the GBC minimum.
rules.guruSetIntro: This guru's rules start from the temple baseline. Values cannot go below the baseline.
rules.param.secondGapMonths: Months between first and second initiation
rules.param.changeGuruMonths: Months to wait after changing guru
rules.param.returnGapMonths: Months to wait after returning to ISKCON
rules.param.letterRequired: The president's written recommendation is required
rules.mustStayOn: The GBC requires this. It cannot be switched off.
rules.optionalSwitch: May be switched on or off.
rules.requiredDocsHint: The checklist asks for these before a file can be sent to the guru's office.
rules.belowFloorSummary: Some values are below the minimum. See the messages beside each field.
rules.saveBeforePublish: Save the draft before you publish.
rules.publishBody: A new version starts now. Files already recommended keep the version they used; open files follow the new version.
rules.discardBody: The unpublished changes are lost. The published version is not affected.
ceremonies.title: Ceremonies
ceremonies.lead: Plan each initiation ceremony, attach people the guru's office has accepted, and complete it to write the register.
ceremonies.caption: Ceremonies, soonest first
ceremonies.emptyHint: Plan a ceremony to attach accepted candidates.
ceremony.heading: {guru}, {date}
ceremony.col.name: Candidate
ceremony.spiritualNamesMissing: Every person who was present needs a spiritual name before you can complete the ceremony.
ceremony.noAttendeesHint: Attach people from the list below.
ceremony.eligibleHint: People the guru's office accepted, for this guru and this kind of initiation, who are not attached to another ceremony.
ceremony.noEligible: Nobody is waiting to be attached.
ceremony.finishBody: Mark who was present, enter each spiritual name, then complete the ceremony. Completing writes the permanent register.
ceremony.completeBody: A register entry will be written for each person present ({count} in all).
ceremony.completeWarning: This writes the permanent register. Entries can be corrected later, with a reason, but not deleted.
ceremony.completed: Ceremony completed. The register is written.
ceremony.completedNote: This ceremony is complete and its register entries are written.
ceremony.cancelBody: Nothing is written to the register. The people attached become available for another ceremony.
register.title: Register
register.lead: The permanent record of initiations, written when a ceremony is completed.
register.caption: Register entries
register.col.name: Name
register.correctIntro: Corrections are audited with your reason. The earlier value stays in the audit log.
register.reasonHint: For example: spelling corrected against the guru's letter.
notifications.title: Notifications
import.title: Import candidates
import.lead: Bring in the temple's existing list from a spreadsheet. You see every row checked before anything is saved.
import.templateHint: Use the same column headings. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
import.previewCaption: Rows in the file with their checks
import.onlyProblems: Show only rows with warnings or errors
import.col.name: Name
import.commitNote: {count} rows can be imported. Rows with errors are skipped.
import.consent: Each person in this file has been told what the temple stores about them and why, and agrees.
import.consentHint: The same consent as when a candidate is added by hand.
import.doneBody: {created} candidates were added. {skipped} rows were skipped.
people.title: People
people.lead: Everyone who can sign in: candidates, mentors, committee, the president and administrators.
people.caption: People
people.col.name: Name
people.activeHint: Turning this off signs the person out everywhere.
people.mfaNote: The temple president and administrators set up an authenticator app the first time they sign in.
people.contactRequired: Enter an email address or a phone number.
gurus.title: Gurus
gurus.lead: The gurus the temple works with. A guru who is not active cannot be chosen for new files.
gurus.name: Name of the guru
audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Who did what and when. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.applicationInvalid: This is not a valid id.
audit.caption: Audit entries, newest first
timeline.guruResponse.wait: The guru's office asked to wait
timeline.guruResponse.wait.withReason: The guru's office asked to wait: {reason}
timeline.package.exported: Package exported for the guru's office ({missing} documents missing)
timeline.register: Entered in the register as {spiritualName}, initiated on {date}

notification.mentorAssigned: {candidateName} has been added and you are the mentor.
notification.fileWaiting: The file of {candidateName} is waiting for your review.
notification.sentBack.staff: The president sent the file of {candidateName} back.
notification.sentBack.staff.withReason: The president sent the file of {candidateName} back. Reason: {reason}
notification.sentBack.self: Your file was sent back for more preparation.
notification.sentBack.self.withReason: Your file was sent back for more preparation. Reason: {reason}
notification.approved.staff: The president recommended {candidateName}. The file goes to the guru's office.
notification.approved.self: The temple president has recommended your file. It now goes to the guru's office.
notification.declined.staff: The file of {candidateName} was declined by {by}.
notification.declined.staff.withReason: The file of {candidateName} was declined by {by}. Reason: {reason}
notification.declined.self: There is an update on your file. Please speak with your mentor.
notification.guruResponse.self: The guru's office has answered your file. Open My path to read it.
notification.documentUploaded: A document ({documentType}) was uploaded to the file of {candidateName}.
notification.ceremonyCompleted.self: Hare Krishna. Your initiation was recorded on {date}.
notification.monthlyNoteDue: A monthly note is due for {count} of your candidates: {names}.
notification.filesWaiting: {count} files are waiting for your review. The oldest has waited {oldestDays} days.
import.email.invalid: The email address is not valid.
import.phone.invalid: The phone number is not valid.
import.date.invalid: {field} is not a valid date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
import.track.invalid: Initiation must be FIRST or SECOND.
import.mentor.ambiguous: More than one mentor matches “{value}”. Use the full name.
import.duplicate.existing: Looks like someone already in the system (same {field}). It will be skipped.
import.duplicate.inFile: Same {field} as line {line} of this file.
import.contact.missing: No phone or email, so no login can be created.
import.cell.formulaLike: {field} starts like a formula and will be read as plain text.
import.practiceSince.notApplied: The practice start date is not imported. The mentor confirms it.
import.row.failed: This row could not be saved.
import.field.name: Name
error.field.RULE_NOT_EXCEPTABLE: This item cannot be covered by an exception.
error.field.NOBODY_PRESENT: Nobody is marked present. Cancel the ceremony instead.
error.field.DATE_IN_FUTURE: A ceremony can only be completed on or after its date ({date}).
error.field.ATTENDEE_NOT_RECOMMENDED: {candidateName} is no longer at the Recommended stage. Detach them first.
error.field.MISSING_COLUMN: The file has no “{column}” column. Use the template.
error.field.NO_ROWS: The file has no rows to import.
error.field.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has too many rows (at most {max}). Split it into smaller files.
